mechanism: Creates a durable {{rollout_manifest}} before enabling the {{ejection_seat}} or dispatching work, then executes the approved `operation_sequence` in an {{execution_manifest}} as state-changing {{act}}s inside a {{circuit_breaker}} envelope. Before dispatching any canary or forward state-changing action, Rollout creates a `prepared` manifest entry containing a discoverable idempotent inverse for {{compensate}} that is safe to invoke when the forward outcome is unknown. The entry becomes `armed` before the action is sent, and its `outcome: unknown` is replaced only when an outcome is observed. If no safe inverse can be prepared, Rollout refuses that action and enters the same terminal cleanup path as a breaker trip. Rollout first runs a bounded real-path {{canary}}. `proceed` is the sole authorization for full execution or commitment of canary progress. On `caution` or `abort`, unless preempted by {{ejection_seat}}, Rollout invokes {{break}}, invokes {{compensate}} for every armed canary entry whose outcome is effectful or `unknown`, records the result, permits only DESTROY or RECYCLE, freezes the manifest, and terminates this run; retry requires a new Rollout. An inverse-preparation failure or breaker trip, unless preempted by {{ejection_seat}}, invokes {{break}}, stops forward execution, invokes {{compensate}} for every armed entry whose outcome is effectful or `unknown`, records every per-inverse result, freezes the manifest, and terminates this run; neither breaker recovery nor retry resumes it, and either requires a new Rollout. A received {{ejection_seat}} signal always takes precedence over all cleanup paths: PAUSE suspends forward and compensation work and leaves the manifest open; TERMINATE stops new forward work, invokes {{break}}, permits best-effort {{compensate}} during graceful shutdown without allowing acknowledgement or cleanup to block termination, and then freezes the manifest; EMERGENCY halts immediately with no compensation and no final-write guarantee, so only an incomplete immutable prefix with no guaranteed final outcome entry is available. Outside EMERGENCY, Rollout freezes the manifest when the run terminates.
gloss: Progressive deployment with canary gating and recorded compensation
failure_modes: Canary false positive: The bounded real path returns `proceed`, but full execution encounters conditions the canary did not cover.
Dirty compensation: One or more recorded inverse actions fails, leaving partial state; the failure remains in the {{rollout_manifest}}.
Forward execution drift: An attempted forward action does not match the next authorized action in the approved {{execution_manifest}} operation sequence.
Audit drift: An armed canary or forward action, or any compensation action, is absent from the {{rollout_manifest}}.
Emergency residue: {{ejection_seat}} EMERGENCY mode halts without cleanup, so effects from already attempted actions can remain.
invariants: No state-changing {{act}} is attempted before the {{rollout_manifest}} records its discoverable idempotent inverse, safe under an `unknown` outcome; otherwise it is refused as an inverse-preparation failure.
`proceed` alone authorizes full execution or committed {{canary}} progress.
`caution`, `abort`, inverse-preparation failure, or a {{circuit_breaker}} trip starts no further forward work and, absent {{ejection_seat}} preemption, enters ordinary terminal cleanup.
Ordinary terminal cleanup invokes {{break}}, then {{compensate}} for every effectful-or-`unknown` armed entry, records each inverse result, and terminates with the manifest frozen.
A terminated Rollout never resumes; retry and breaker recovery use a new Rollout.
A received {{ejection_seat}} signal preempts ordinary cleanup in favor of its selected mode.
PAUSE suspends forward and compensation work and leaves the Rollout and its manifest open.
TERMINATE starts no further forward work, invokes {{break}}, and permits best-effort {{compensate}}; Break acknowledgement and cleanup cannot block termination with a frozen manifest.
EMERGENCY halts immediately without cleanup or a final manifest write.

Outside EMERGENCY, the {{rollout_manifest}} records every armed action, compensation action, and observed inverse result; at freeze, each forward entry contains its observed outcome or `unknown` if unobserved.
preconditions: {{circuit_breaker}} is configured for the operation target and CLOSED
{{canary}} telemetry collection is active for the bounded path
{{ejection_seat}} readiness has a recorded successful test and its dedicated channel, operator key, and operator are available
postconditions: If the run terminates without EMERGENCY, the {{rollout_manifest}} is frozen with each armed action and its observed or `unknown` outcome.
If EMERGENCY occurs, immediate halt is the only guaranteed outcome; the durable {{rollout_manifest}} may contain only an incomplete immutable prefix with no guaranteed final outcome entry.
